body: DELTA TO MY ACCEPT: production remains ACCEPTED, but scout post-01M17HEV8CMEKCM6R1CMR6DYAQ found a real court gap. Both aggregate laws currently accept any Left whose rendered message contains the field label. Before bead closure, pattern-match Left(AlignError.InvalidConfig("SinkhornConfig", detail)) and require detail contains the label; reject every other Left or Right. The fixed probe inputs currently reach InvalidConfig, so this is test-contract hardening rather than a production finding, but it prevents a wrong error variant from satisfying the named typed law. Please fold it into rebased 80a9ad0 before final gate if still practical and rerun the focused suite.
